prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 330, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 331, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 332, 'component': 'Alerting Engine', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 480}, {'i': 333, 'component': 'Account Recovery Service', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 334, 'component': 'Health Monitor', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 335, 'component': 'Central Reporting Data Store', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 336, 'component': 'Backup & Restore Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 337, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 338, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 339, 'component': 'Central Metrics Pipeline', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 340, 'component': 'Central Metrics Pipeline', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 341, 'component': 'Health Monitor', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 342, 'component': 'VPN Gateway', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 343, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 344, 'component': 'Account Recovery Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}]
